# DBX

> Per-tenant memory engine for AI products: one isolated store per customer, holding working state and vector memory.

- Site: https://dbxdb.io/
- Contact: hello@dbxdb.io
- License: Business Source License 1.1 (Apache 2.0 after four years)
- Source: https://github.com/vanshjain-0702/DBX-Database-Extreme

## What it is

Self-hosted single binary. Orchestrator HTTP on :8000. Authenticated RESP on :6380.
Each tenant is a directory with its own WAL, HNSW (SQ8), and snapshots — not a key prefix on a shared cluster.

v1 supported profile: 100 tenants/node, 100k vectors/tenant, durable strings + vectors.
Async WAL replicas optional (primary acks locally). Raft, cluster, and non-string RESP mutations fail closed.

Operator HTTP (JWT on :8000): provision, keys, backup/restore, export/import,
hibernate/wake, GET /api/v1/tenants/{id}/usage, GET /api/usage.
Prometheus: GET /metrics (Bearer JWT or internal token in production). JSON: GET /t/{id}/metrics.

Density: CI soaks 12 idle / 4 active. Operators run `make soak` (100 idle / 25 active).
That is not a 100-orchestrator-process soak. 15-minute path: examples/quickstart.py.

Launch: reader keys cannot SET/VADD. Production /metrics needs Bearer. No default
superuser on orchestrator tenants. TLS on :8000. Not SOC 2. Not a cluster.

## Do not say

Redis replacement. All-in-one AI database. Cheaper than Pinecone. Scales to billions of vectors. SOC 2.
